messages.content: I'm not able to add google sign in into this ide application

To help you get this sorted, here is what you need to know depending on what you're trying to do:

---

### 1. If you want to add Google Sign-In into an app you are building
Your project workspace is currently fresh. We can set up Google Sign-In using any of the standard integration methods:

* **Google Identity Services (GSI / OAuth 2.0)**:
  Uses the official Google JavaScript library (`https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client`) to render the standard **"Sign in with Google"** button or One Tap prompt on your frontend.
* **Firebase Auth**:
  Quickest setup if you want complete user session handling (`signInWithPopup(auth, new GoogleAuthProvider())`).
* **Supabase / Auth.js / NextAuth**:
  Great if you're building a full-stack application with a backend database.

> [!TIP]
> To use real Google Sign-In in a web app, you will need a **Google OAuth Client ID** from the [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials) with your app's origin in the *Authorized JavaScript origins*. 
> 
> Let me know your preferred stack (e.g., **HTML/JS**, **React / Vite**, or **Next.js**), and whether you have a Client ID or want to start with a working demo template!

---

### 2. If you are trying to sign into this IDE (Antigravity) with Google
* **You are already authenticated**: Your connection is live and the agent is actively running on your session.
* **How authentication works**: The mobile app links through the relay bridge automatically. If your Google session ever expires or requires renewal, the agent will display a Google authorization link directly in this chat for you to approve and paste the one-time code.
